title: Requests to bring back physical controls and features
summary: This topic is mainly a set of requests to restore physical buttons, simpler access to functions, and a few older features, with little explicit sentiment beyond those requests.

negative.summary: The negative review criticizes having to take extra steps in the interface to reach and adjust heater controls.

mixed.summary: The mixed review focuses on a broader reliability and replacement dispute rather than a clear request to bring back a specific feature, so the examples are insufficient for a tighter topic-level pattern.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly ask for the return of physical buttons, climate controls, a printed manual, dual aircon, a CD player, or quicker access to map and drive-mode functions.

limitations: Most fragments are undetermined requests or wishes, so explicit sentiment evidence is limited.
The cluster includes some unrelated or weakly related uses of the word 'bring', such as a reliability dispute and comments not clearly about restoring controls or features.
Samples are stratified and limited, so they should not be treated as representative of all feedback on this topic.
